name: North Texas lake (Lake Ray Hubbard)
note: Everything about the region that isn't code: where it applies, its climate and seasons, which map data its placement rules read, its sizes, its shared material slots and colours. Each track's file beside this one (ground.json, grass.json, ...) lists that track's assets for the region and where each goes. Layout: docs/env-loop/packs.md.

place.climate: Koppen Cfa: hot humid summers, mild winters, 990 mm of rain a year, warm-season grasses go dormant (tan) from late November to early April

summer.note: lawns green while watered, rough grass straw by August, every deciduous tree in full leaf

dormant.note: bermuda and St. Augustine tan, cedar elm and pecan bare, live oak and eastern red cedar green

spring.note: green-up from late March, bluebonnets and wildflowers on verges in April

fall.note: late, short colour: cedar elm yellow, Shumard oak red, mid November

map_data.heights: Content/TerrainData/RayHubbard.height (5 m) + RayHubbard.detail (1 m lidar shore band)
map_data.houses: RayHubbard.houses (footprints as wings, storeys, roof shape and colour, commercial flag)
map_data.lots: HouseKit.cpp's lot dressing (lake.py lot()): bank type, boathouse, street side
map_data.osm: OSM piers, landuse and roads already in the bakes

hand_placed.note: only the home club (the marina json) is placed by hand; everything else by the rules in the track files
